title: Venture Holdings BV - acquisition of DMG Industries Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced that it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Venture Holdings BV acquired DMG Industries Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not reach a conclusive view in relation to market definition as it did not consider it was a critical issue, but used the following definitions for consideration of the acquisition: a national market for the production and supply of plastic automotive parts; and a national market for the production and supply of the tools required to make those parts.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC took into consideration the views of market participants in reaching the conclusion that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition.  Imports were considered a significant constraint in both markets as well as in downstream markets.  Furthermore, many large customers were considered to have considerable countervailing power.
